def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

def fill_regions(I):
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(I[i]))==1 and I[i][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({I[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1 and I[0][j]!=bg]
    # regions
    def spans(n,seps):
        s=[]; start=0
        for k in sorted(seps)+[n]:
            if k>start: s.append((start,k))
            start=k+1
        return s
    R=spans(h,sep_rows); C=spans(w,sep_cols)
    regions=[(r,c) for r in R for c in C]
    # pattern region: has a cell not bg
    def cells(r,c): return [(i,j) for i in range(*r) for j in range(*c)]
    pr=next((r,c) for r,c in regions if any(I[i][j]!=bg for i,j in cells(r,c)))
    top,left=pr[0][0],pr[1][0]
    pat=[[I[top+i][left+j] for j in range(pr[1][1]-pr[1][0])] for i in range(pr[0][1]-pr[0][0])]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r,c in regions:
        for i in range(*r):
            for j in range(*c):

    return out

    out=[]; start=0

        start=k+1

def background(grid):
    """The most frequent color in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def separator_rows(grid, line=None):
    """Indices of rows that are one color throughout, that color not the background (or == line if given)."""
    bg=background(grid)
    return [i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]

def separator_cols(grid, line=None):
    """Indices of columns that are one color throughout, that color not the background."""
    bg=background(grid)
    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid})==1 and grid[0][j]!=bg]

def tile_regions(grid):
    """Fill every region between separator rows/cols with the pattern block from the region that holds non-background content, anchored at that region's top-left."""
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    R=spans(h,separator_rows(grid)); C=spans(w,separator_cols(grid))
    regions=[(r,c) for r in R for c in C]
